name: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong (RSMH)

ai_summary: Scenic Half Marathon Rayong (RSMH) is a road race organized by Scenic Marathon Series, scheduled for August 2, 2026, at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand. Registration for the race is currently open, allowing participants to sign up ahead of the event date.

faqs.question: When and where is the Scenic Half Marathon Rayong held?
faqs.answer: This race takes place on August 2, 2026, at Laem Charoen Public Park in Rayong, Thailand. The event is organized by Scenic Marathon Series, and the venue serves as the starting point for both the 21.1 km half marathon and the 10 km race offered on race day.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
